question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or should this progress signal remain an internal bundled-runtime seam?
rationale: The Slack fix needs a cross-plugin typed boundary, but exporting it creates a lasting external API and suppression contract that repository policy requires maintainers to approve explicitly.

options.title: Approve and document the SDK contract
options.body: Keep the generic public metadata seam, document its producer and channel semantics, and require exact-head live Slack proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the signal internal
options.body: Replace the public exports and raised SDK budgets with an owner-approved bundled-only seam while retaining typed Slack suppression behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic public metadata seam, document its producer and channel semantics, and require exact-head live Slack proof before merge.
